concepts.label: MapReduce Views from the Java SDK (deprecated)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - MapReduce Views are a pre-SQL++ Couchbase feature with no SQL++ statement equivalent at all, so there is no n1ql:* concept to reuse. The page is also thin/deprecation-notice content rather than a real howto.

relations.subject: sdk:view-queries-with-sdk
relations.evidence: Views are the only service which does not benefit from Multi-Dimensional Scaling, and is rarely the best choice over, say, [our Query service](sqlpp-queries-with-sdk.md) if you are starting a fresh application.

cross_product_finding: MapReduce Views is the strongest 'no statement to reuse at all' case in the batch: it predates SQL++/N1QL entirely, is deprecated in the SDK, and 'not available in Capella Operational, only in self-managed Couchbase Server' - i.e. it doesn't even exist in the cloud/ product family that the other reconciliation batch covers. There is no ambiguity here about statement-vs-SDK-specific: Views have no statement-level artifact, so the concept is necessarily SDK/product-specific (sdk:view-queries-with-sdk), not a candidate for n1ql:* reuse.
